description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for AbortController/AbortSignal: a {signal} listener is removed on abort(); signal.aborted and signal.reason reflect the abort. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/wpt_b/dom_abortsignal`, and the server-side grader compares it with the Chrome-baked expected answer.
title: AbortSignal removes listener on abort; aborted/reason state
